    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Fill the periodic 5-color texture. For each row, fit phase to existing texture,
    # restricting candidates to the recurring palette and ignoring decorative 2/4.
    pat=[1,3,5,7,9]
    for i,row in enumerate(out):
        known=[(j,v) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v in pat]
        scores=[sum(v==pat[(j+p)%5] for j,v in known) for p in range(5)]
        phase=max(range(5), key=lambda p:scores[p])
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==0:
                # All zeroes in this grid lie in the texture or its frame/background;

                out[i][j]=pat[(j+phase)%5]

            if grid[i][j]==0 and ((i==2 and 11<=j<=17) or (j==2 and i in range(2,9))):

''')
